notes: Stories already complete, properly scoped, and non-duplicative. No new IDs created per constraints.

EVAL-CT-M3-S1.title: Define Proximity Metric Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M3-S1.description: Define structured schema for trial proximity including distance (miles/km), travel duration (minutes), origin, destination, and fallback indicators when routing fails.

EVAL-CT-M3-S2.title: Implement Distance and Travel Time Computation
EVAL-CT-M3-S2.description: Implement logic to call Google Routes API to compute distance and travel time from user location to each clinical trial site, including batching, response caching, rate-limit handling, and graceful fallback behavior.

EVAL-CT-M3-S3.title: Expose Proximity Data via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M3-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include proximity metrics in clinical trial results returned to the chat layer, ensuring schema alignment with contract.

EVAL-CT-M3-S4.title: Integrate Proximity with Trial Location Extraction
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.description: Ensure proximity calculations are applied across all extracted trial locations, correctly handling multiple sites per trial and selecting the nearest site for output.

EVAL-CT-M3-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Proximity Calculation
EVAL-CT-M3-S5.description: Add tests covering distance/time computation, multi-site selection, missing location handling, API failure fallback, caching behavior, and end-to-end validation through the facade.
